name: Alarm.Com
outlook:
What Alarm.Com says to expect

  • Full year 2026: SaaS and license revenueSaaS and license revenue is now expected to be in the range of $756.1 million to $756.3 million, up $12.2 million from the midpoint of the full year of 2026 SaaS and license revenue guidance provided in February 2026.
  • Full year 2026: total revenueTotal revenue is expected to be in the range of $1.1011 billion to $1.1113 billion, which includes anticipated hardware and other revenue in the range of $345.0 million to $355.0 million.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted net income per shareBased on an expected 56.3 million weighted average diluted shares outstanding, non-GAAP adjusted net income attributable to common stockholders is expected to be $3.02 to $3.04 per diluted share.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
